description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Fetch and read the web] Text statistics for the main content of one page: word, sentence and character counts, Flesch reading ease and Flesch-Kincaid grade (English), level, long-sentence ratio, reading and speaking time, and top terms. Computed by formula, no AI. Cached 1 h. ~0.3-2 s.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.
